title: Bond Voyage! Organic Reactions
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B organic reactions five ways: Identify the Reaction, Draw the Product, Draw the Reactant, Name It, and Full Reaction (reactant, reaction type, product, then name). Students draw structures on a built-in drawing pad with automatic hydrogens, and can practice with skeletal, condensed, expanded, or mixed structure styles. Reactions cover alkanes and alkenes; alcohols, aldehydes, and ketones; and carboxylic acids, esters, amines, and amides. Includes hints, answer reveals, XP, streaks, achievement badges, and a Dr. Dan video playlist.
